not_checked.cause: Wall-clock timeout truncation of the mutation run. DEFAULT_RUNTIME['target'] = 1800s with default serial execution (--max-children 0), against ~3409s of estimated serial work for loan. mutmut schedules mutants fastest-first, so the slowest were never reached and received no exit code (mutmut maps None -> 'not checked').
not_checked.proof: Status is a pure monotonic function of estimated execution time: deciles 1-7 (est <= 2.30s) are 100% evaluated; deciles 9-10 (est >= 4.89s) are 100% not_checked; a single clean cutoff at ~4.1s.
not_checked.resolution: Re-ran with existing CLI flags --max-runtime 7200 --max-children 4. Loan completed in 653s with not_checked = 0.
not_checked.m9_c42_18_stated_cause: 'no covering tests' — FACTUALLY INCORRECT; all 6 affected functions had 36-193 associated tests, and mutmut maps missing tests to exit code 33 ('no tests'), never to 'not checked'.

post_run_reporting_context_defect.cause: mutation_runner.py restores the pre-run [tool.mutmut] block (lines 605-608) BEFORE collecting evidence via `mutmut results` (lines 638-646). The restored block names a different engine, so mutmut resolves an empty population and the runner reports all zeros with evidence_complete=false.
post_run_reporting_context_defect.recommended_fix: Collect `mutmut results` BEFORE restoring the pre-run config, or pass the engine-scoped config explicitly to the results invocation.
